title: salix myricoides var. angustifolia
intro: Salix myricoides var. angustifolia, commonly known as the narrowleaf willow or smallflower willow, is a shrub or small tree species in the willow family (Salicaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Salix myricoides var. angustifolia include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
